alpha_v0.1.description:
The humble beginnings of Goldeneye for Archipelago by that guy you remember making video game covers when you were in high school.

Items:

- All guns (individually or progressive)
- Level Unlocks

Locations:

- Objective Clears (per map or per difficulty)
- Level Clears (per map or per difficulty)

Traps:

- Goldeneye Trap :^)

Known issues:

- Random crashes that require a full close and reopen of Bizhawk. Progress should be saved when you reopen.
- Bond takes out his starting gun sometimes but then he puts it away again remembering the rules. Uses it to bludgeon guards.
- Deathlink sometimes doesn't trigger, namely usually the first one.
- Recieving Deathlink makes a garbled mess on the screen. Do not fear child, that is the debug menu.

v0,2.description:
### Goldeneye Multiworld Archipelago v0.2

Full code refactor to be more modular and robust. Far less reliance on AI as I'm becoming more confident with flesh coding. Now uses a patched rom vs the Everything_Unlocked Patch. Streamlined [install and setup](https://github.com/NotFamilyJules/goldeneye_ap/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md). 

[Release Trailer with Video Setup](https://youtu.be/sY99KyXEgXQ)

**Quick Start**

1. Install the latest Archipelago and BizHawk, then download goldeneye.apworld from this page’s releases. Optional: install the latest PopTracker and Vincent’sSin’s GoldenEye tracker pack.
2. Close all Archipelago windows, double-click goldeneye.apworld to install, then reopen the Launcher. Create and export your YAML using Options Creator.
3. Send your YAML to your host or generate your own game. Open your .apge with ArchipelagoLauncher.exe. When prompted, select EmuHawk.exe and your unpatched USA GoldenEye .z64 ROM.
4. BizHawk, the client, and Lua should launch and connect automatically. Leave the 8 MiB Expansion Pak enabled. You’re ready to play!

**Items:**

- All guns (individually or progressive)
- Key Items
- Loadout Items
- Level Unlocks
- Cheats
- Ammo Fillers (adds to your starting pool of that weapon)
- Health Packs / Armor

**Locations:**

- Objective Clears (per map or per difficulty)
- Level Clears (per map or per difficulty)
- Freestanding Objects and Weapons
- NPC Dropped Key Items
- NPC Handoff Items
- Cheat Unlocks

**Traps:**

- Goldeneye Trap
- Holster Gun Trap
- Auto-Fail Trap

**Added Features**

- Quick Equip using D-pad
- Randomized Music
- Randomized SFX
- Randomized NPC Heads/Bodies
- Randomized Guard Loadouts
- Enemy Weapons pickups are vanilla, just ammo, or nothing
- In-Game Item Tracker (F8 to close)
- Poptracker by Vincent'sSin

**Known issues:**

- Depot Ammo Cache Crash - Sometimes picking up the items in the ammo cache room causes bizhawk to crash. I've investigated extensively but haven't been able to recreate it.
- Depot Final Hanger Armor - This armor has been known to be picked up but not send a check. Not sure why as I also can't replicate this one.
v0,2.title: Goldeneye AP v0.2
